# Inkscape MCP

> FastMCP server for SVG construction, Inkscape CLI automation, and native Linux
> desktop editing. Entry point: `uv run inkscape-mcp`. Python 3.12+.

- [README](README.md): project scope, verified environment, quick start, credits.
- [Installation](INSTALL.md): Ubuntu 26.04 native dependencies, source install, MCP client setup.
- [Tools](docs/TOOLS.md): every registered MCP tool and operation, parameters, current limits.
- [Usage](docs/USAGE.md): construction, export, live insertion, multiple documents, save/close.
- [Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md): YAML, environment, stdio/HTTP, desktop state.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): dependency, session, extension, export failures.
- [Development](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md): tests and source layout.
- [Sampling](docs/AI_SAMPLING.md): optional client sampling versus dashboard providers.
- [Upstream integration](docs/UPSTREAM_INTEGRATION.md): lineage and native bridge design.
- [Extended agent guide](llms-full.txt): operational rules and tool selection.

Default transport: stdio. Standalone HTTP default: 127.0.0.1:11027, MCP path /mcp.
Dashboard backend: explicitly use port 11028; Bun/Vite frontend: 11029.
Native desktop insertion uses the bundled inkex effect and explicit session IDs,
not keyboard focus or clipboard paste. Install with `install_live_extension`,
then restart any already-open target windows once.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/GianluDeveloper/inkscape-mcp
Base: https://github.com/sandraschi/inkscape-mcp
Native bridge upstream: https://github.com/aravindev/inkscape_mcp
License and attribution: [LICENSE](LICENSE), [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).
